chat.author: Britta Hale
chat.text:
Mike Ounsworth said:

Britta Hale You could also imagine half-SNS, right? Where one of the components' standalone validation will fail when extracted from the hybrid, but the other's wont. Right?

No, SNS is that the entire verification fails if separation occurs. There shouldn't be a way to do "half" of that... Security definitions should not (and SNS was defined thus) allow something to sound stronger than a weaker version. "Half SNS" according to that description is objectively weaker than WNS. 
Also, the attacker in a nested case would just redefine the message to include the missing signature.
